# The Lore of Gol

## Locations

### <a id="aldenburg"></a>Aldenburg

Aldenburg is a city in Kriega. It is the origin city of the Aldward family; the surname "Aldward" means "ward of Aldenburg."

### <a id="aprus"></a>Aprus

Aprus is a country in the Krieger Imperium, bordering Eglon. Its capital is Verantia. During the Imperium's expansion, Aprus surrendered after only a few weeks of fighting. Aprus is also renowned across Gol for its saffron trade.

### <a id="citadel"></a>Citadel

The Citadel is a city, an organization, an academy, and ultimately an idea — anyone who wishes to learn the Lengua Arcana aspires to study there and earn their name-cloak. It sits at the center of arcane life on Gol. The Citadel was founded 1,424 years ago, the date used as the basis for "Citadel dating," which makes the current year 1424.

## Characters

### <a id="kriggy-krieger"></a>Kriggy Krieger*

Kriggy Krieger is a roughly 65-year-old human of the Krieger royal family, the first-born sibling and older brother of the current Emperor Tiberius Krieger. Appointed a top general, he was removed from duty and hidden away after a publicly known defeat, and later set off incognito as "Ambrose Chamberlain" to prove himself, accompanied by his guard Skjöldr Aldvarðr.

### <a id="skjöldr-aldvarðr"></a>Skjöldr Aldvarðr*

Skjöldr Aldvarðr is a roughly 90-year-old dwarf of the Aldward family from Aldenburg in Kriega. He has served as the personal bodyguard of the prince Kriggy Krieger since Kriggy's youth, and reluctantly follows him on his journey, also chaperoning his much-younger niece CJ.

## History

- <a id="final-conquests-and-integration"></a>**Final Conquests and Integration** — ~40 years ago. The Taken Lands of Tiber were fully integrated into the Krieger Imperium, which then moved into Cray Blar and Pyo.
- <a id="the-founding-of-the-citadel"></a>**The Founding of the Citadel** — 1,424 years ago. The Citadel was founded 1,424 years before the present, the event that anchors Citadel dating and makes the present year 1424.
- <a id="the-maltraavkriega-war"></a>**The Maltraav–Kriega War** — ~200 years ago. War erupted between Kriega and the Twelve Houses of Maltraav after Maltraavian houses ransacked Kriegan border towns; the Citadel allied with Kriega and Maltraav was pushed back.
- <a id="the-battle-of-the-cloud-mountains"></a>**The Battle of the Cloud Mountains** — ~200 years ago. Remembered as the most brutal stretch of the war with Maltraav.
- <a id="the-reign-of-emperor-ferridus-krieger"></a>**The Reign of Emperor Ferridus Krieger** — ~200–150 years ago. Ferridus Krieger was the first emperor of the Krieger Imperium.
- <a id="the-reign-of-emperor-hadrius-krieger"></a>**The Reign of Emperor Hadrius Krieger** — ~150–100 years ago. Hadrius Krieger succeeded Ferridus.
- <a id="the-krakenblood-symphony"></a>**The Krakenblood Symphony** — ~120 years ago. Fought at the Free Islands, the Imperium's worst loss, cementing the freedom of the Dwarven Free Islands.
- <a id="the-birth-of-the-sailors-grave"></a>**The Birth of the Sailors' Grave** — ~120 years ago. A notable battle of the expansion, remembered from the campaign in Aprus.
- <a id="imperial-expansion-begins"></a>**Imperial Expansion Begins** — ~120 years ago. The Krieger Imperium began expanding outward from Kriega, seizing most of the countries around Lake Mundi.
- <a id="the-reign-of-empress-odessus-krieger"></a>**The Reign of Empress Odessus Krieger** — ~100–50 years ago. Odessus Krieger succeeded Hadrius.
- <a id="the-reign-of-emperor-tiberius-krieger"></a>**The Reign of Emperor Tiberius Krieger** — ~50 years ago–present. Tiberius Krieger succeeded Odessus and rules the Krieger Imperium to this day.
- <a id="the-failed-stand-of-the-weeping-moors"></a>**The Failed Stand of the Weeping Moors** — ~40 years ago. The notable engagement of the Cray Blar campaign, and the publicly known defeat at the center of Kriggy Krieger's disgrace.
